caveats:
These boundaries are of higher geographic quality than the [Türkiye - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tur) COD-AB, and do not match the COD-AB exactly.

P-codes were derived from the source except in administrative level 1 feature "ELAZIĞ" [TUR023] where the administrative level 3 P-codes were created by OCHA.

notes:
Türkiye southeast - Subnational Administrative Level 1-3 boundaries and gazetteer

These tables extend the official [Türkiye - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tur) to administrative level 3 in thirteen of the south-eastern provinces (vilayet).  

PLEASE SEE CAVEATS.
